other_failure_modes.name: Failure to subsample large datasets
other_failure_modes.description: The agent attempts to load and train on the entire dataset without checking its size or applying subsampling. For massive datasets (like NYC Taxi Fare with ~55M rows), this leads to Out-Of-Memory (OOM) errors or execution timeouts.

summary: The agent provides a well-structured solution with excellent feature engineering for spatial and temporal data. However, it fails to account for the massive scale of the dataset, leading to an execution timeout. Methodologically, it relies on a random train-test split for temporal data and only evaluates the stochastic model once using a single metric.
